entities.summary: Miguel Reale was a Brazilian jurist, philosopher, academic, politician and poet, known as one of the most important Brazilian jurists and as an exponent of the Three-dimensional theory of law. He was one of the leaders of Integralism in Brazil and an ideologue of the Brazilian Integralist Action.
